profileSnapshot.name: Explore
profileSnapshot.description: Read-only search agent for broad fan-out searches - when answering means sweeping many files, directories, or naming conventions and you only need the conclusion, not the file dumps. It reads excerpts rather than whole files, so it locates code; it doesn't review or audit it. Specify search breadth: "medium" for moderate exploration, "very thorough" for multiple locations and naming conventions.

prompt:
In the ZCode app bundle /Applications/ZCode.app/Contents/Resources/glm/zcode.cjs (14 MB minified JS — use python3 re/str.find with UTF-8 errors="ignore", avoid complex regex), investigate how subagent/model failures surface so a dynamic-workflow script can catch them:

1. What error is produced when a model is exhausted (quota/billing): search for error messages containing "quota", "billing", "balance", "entitlement", "exhaust", "429", "insufficient". Report the exact error codes/messages and whether they are distinguishable (e.g. error.code or error kind fields).
2. What happens when a subagent (dynamic workflow agent() call) gets a model error: does the workflow node fail with a typed error the script can catch? Search for the dynamic workflow runtime strings: "dwf_", "agent(", "workflow", "node failed", "provider error". Report any error-shape schemas (e.g. {code, message, kind}).
3. The subagent_model option semantics: search for "subagent_model" / "subagentModel" — does it accept "providerId/modelId" (like "account:zai-start-plan/GLM-5.3-Flash" or "failover/security-auditor")? What happens with an unknown model id?
4. Retry behavior: is there any built-in retry/attempt logic for provider errors in the workflow runtime (search "retry", "attempt") that would interfere with script-level catch-and-retry?

Report exact strings/schemas found, with short context. This determines how a script implements try Start Plan model -> catch quota error -> fall back to failover model.
